issues.description: nevra[0] uses the filename's first character instead of the package name's first letter, breaking koji's Packages subdirectory convention
issues.detail: Koji's Packages tree is keyed by the lowercased first letter of the package name, not the NEVRA filename. The code works by accident today but conflates two different things. Parse the package name properly and compute first_letter explicitly, with a named variable that makes the data shape obvious.

issues.description: extract_arch_from_url silently returns None, producing a malformed URL with the literal string 'None' in the path
issues.detail: When the regex misses, the function returns None and the caller interpolates it into an f-string, yielding '.../latest/None/Packages/...'. A quiet data corruption becomes a 404 far from the cause. Either raise on miss or have the caller check and skip with a loud error.

issues.description: Hardcoded arch list and koji base URL should be hoisted to module-level constants
issues.detail: The four-arch list and koji_url_base are load-bearing constants duplicated or buried in function bodies. A module-level ARCHES tuple and KOJI_URL_BASE constant make the data structure visible, let callers reuse it, and reduce drift when paths or arches change. One edit instead of a grep.

issues.description: No unit tests for the new pure URL-rewriting functions despite trivial testability
issues.detail: Both use_koji_url_only and extract_arch_from_url are pure, deterministic, and testable with ~15-20 lines covering coreos-pool passthrough, fedora x86_64, fedora-secondary ppc64le, and edge-case filenames. Such a test would have caught both the nevra[0] and None-arch defects. The author's note that rpms.lock.yaml can't be tested locally is more reason to test the parts that can.

issues.description: Stale prioritize-coreos-pool logic in query_packages_location is now redundant with use_koji_url_only
issues.detail: The downstream rewrite makes the upstream prioritization either vestigial or load-bearing for a reason that isn't documented. Either delete it as half a finished refactor, or add a comment explaining why both filters must exist. Don't leave the reader guessing which half is dead weight.

issues.description: Regex with word boundaries is overkill; the function name and race-condition invariant should be documented in code
issues.detail: For n=4 arches in a slash-delimited URL, split on '/' and intersect with the arch set reads more clearly than a compiled regex with \b. Additionally, the race-with-koji-tagger assumption lives only in the commit message; a literate comment in the code (and a better function name like rewrite_to_coreos_pool_urls) would save the next maintainer hours.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. The approach — synthesizing canonical koji URLs to bypass dnf5's broken baseurl — is sound, but two concrete defects must be fixed: nevra[0] conflates filename-first-char with package-name-first-letter (works by accident), and extract_arch_from_url silently returns None which interpolates into a malformed URL. Both arose because invariants weren't asserted and constants weren't hoisted. Add unit tests for the two new pure functions, lift the arch list and koji base URL to module scope, and either delete or document the now-redundant prioritization in query_packages_location.
